notes.title: Day One Patch💘
notes.content:
Text:
We are very grateful to everyone who spent this weekend on the Island of Love!
We read your feedback with love and rejoiced for everyone 💋
To make your vacation even better, we are releasing the Day One Patch. It includes:
Added Asian languages

Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)
Japanese
Korean
Fixed bug when switching languages
Fixed other bugs

💌 With love,
the Anime Mania team
